title: Power-Up Ludo
description: Supercharge classic Aeroplane Chess with explosive power-up cards, turbo boosts, and shield skills for wildly unpredictable tabletop comebacks.
controls: Roll the dice, deploy special power cards, and move your fleet around the board first to win.

zh-CN.title: 飞行棋大招版
zh-CN.description: 爽快升级桌游飞行棋大招版：在经典摇骰起飞基础上加入酷炫道具大招，逆风翻盘轰飞对手棋子欢乐加倍！
zh-CN.controls: 点击摇骰子移动飞机，巧用加速护盾等大招卡片抢先全员抵达终点夺冠。
